narrative.headline: Find local guides and experiences with published request, fee and participant evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Discover a bounded Japanese shortlist, inspect local association conditions, and compare notice, party and fee rules before choosing a date. Saved observations retain their source and retrieval times; availability remains unknown.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public anonymous JAPAN47GO SSR pages; no API key or browser required. Provider reads only.

troubleshoots.symptom: No candidates in a bounded page window
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect coverage and broaden --query or deliberately increase --max-pages.

troubleshoots.symptom: Saved observation is absent or old
troubleshoots.fix: Use services inspect UUID --refresh before relying on source conditions.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japanese local guide-association request conditions and selected experiences where notice, party size, qualified fees or route durations matter. Inspect details before making a recommendation and cite the source with observation time.
anti_triggers: Live inventory, opening now or guaranteed operation
Broad complete event recommendations or personal suitability
